CAUDALIO 4.4.0 — Validation, 6 November 2026

Released: Linux amd64 (Ubuntu 24.04 / Mint 22) and Windows x64.
New: up to eight independent canvases, per-canvas resolutions, boards,
timelines and outputs; global transport and video blackout; whole-show save,
recovery and media collection; legacy single-canvas project compatibility.
F11 targets the main workspace correctly after switching canvas tabs.

Native tests of the exact shipped application binaries:
LINUX
core: 65 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped
interface: 42 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
sequences: 13 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
monitoring: 9 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
chroma: 20 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
multicanvas: 15 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
opengl: 12 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped

WINDOWS
core: 65 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped
interface: 42 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
sequences: 13 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
monitoring: 9 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
chroma: 20 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
multicanvas: 15 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped

Linux: native installation, installed version 4.4.0, real GUI capture,
FFmpeg decode/audio conversion, OpenGL via Mesa/Xvfb. GPU tests exercise
four UHD framebuffer allocations and rendering. This is software rendering,
not certification of four physical 4K projector outputs.

Windows: native runtime tests, installer build, clean installation,
installed executable hash comparison, installed version 4.4.0, real GUI
capture, FFmpeg decode/audio conversion, reinstall and uninstall, user
AppData preservation. Unsigned installer. CPU fallback was tested on the
hosted runner; a physical Windows GPU was not available for validation.

Additional local checks: six calendar tests; 60-second stress exercise with
eight concurrent canvases, 536 tab switches, video blackout cycles and
whole-show save/reload. The native multi-canvas suite also checks F11.

macOS: installer NOT RELEASED. Preliminary Intel compilation, seven CTest
suites, Cocoa and OpenGL tests passed before the final F11 correction.
The bundle signing order was corrected in source after a packaging failure.
The corrected Mac package has not completed final native validation. No Apple
Silicon native installer or Apple notarization is claimed.

Limits: no finite test suite guarantees a bug-free show. Physical projectors,
capture devices, external audio, MIDI/OSC controllers, optional NDI runtime,
and prolonged real-show workloads require rehearsal on the target setup.
One optional NDI test is skipped where the separate NDI runtime is absent.
Global transport is not frame-locked synchronization. Blackout affects video;
use Stop to stop audio. Up to 8 canvases, 64 MP per canvas / 128 MP combined.
Projects saved in 4.4 require version 4.4 or later; retain original backups.
The 14-day trial and existing commercial licensing remain in place.
